node.title: Re: Hyperlink Question
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: This is more of a VBA question than a Perl question, since [mod://Win32::OLE] basically gives you direct access to that API. The problem seems to stem from how Word internally implements hyperlinks, and retreiving the contents of the document is not as straightforward as character indexes when there are hyperlinks present. For example, if you add print "<",$d->Range(62,111)->{Text},">\n"; to your code after adding the hyperlink, you'll see the output . Perhaps something like [https://stackoverflow.com/a/39785963|this SO answer] could be helpful to you in implementing this correctly. Once you have the code figured out in the VBA world, it should be trivial to translate it to Perl.
